title: Backward insertion
prompt: Implement `void insertAfterEvens(ArrayList<Integer> nums)`: insert 0 immediately after every even element. Insertions shift right — a forward loop re-processes its own insertions forever. [2, 3, 4] → [2, 0, 3, 4, 0].

tests.name: zeros inserted
tests.hint: Backward: for i from size-1 down to 0, if get(i) even, add(i + 1, 0).
